page.layout: One text column, centre-right of the scan. Margin notes in a narrow column at the right edge, blurred and largely unreadable. Catchword at the lower right of the text column. Other printed page on the scan (the facing page edge, with a faint header "QUAEST.") is not transcribed.

main_text.p: deque habet: Inter balistas & fra-gores, inter sudes & saxa, inter fa-ces & incendia grassatur in Princi-pem ac Optimates, etiam per suum latus. Theatrum est Mos-cua, Moscoviæ metropolis, in qua trux Erynnis, lugubrem nuper exhibuit Tragœdiam, quæ locu-ples testimonium faciat meæ Sen-tentiæ. Res ita se habet. An-no 1648. 1. Mai., Moscoviæ & Russiæ Imperator, cum Patriar-cha & Clero, ac præcipuis regni proceribus (Bojardos vocant) ad solennem, quæ quotannis isto die peragisolet, Supplicationem accin-gitur: Cives Moscuenses, oportu-num rati, querimoniam scripto ediderant, eam ad Imperatoris genua, dum pietati vacaret, dela-turi: querebantur immensis se ve-Etigalibus[?], quæ aliquot jam annos pendebant, exhaustos: quod miseris à

page.notes: The marginal notes at the right edge are too blurred to read; they are not transcribed. The catchword "duro" is printed in italic at the lower right. The word "Etigalibus" (vectigalibus, with the first letter in a ligature-like form) is doubtful. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept as printed.
